title: Your app just got a second user
summary: Chat lets people ask an app for more than its screens were built for, and an AI agent becomes its second user. This talk shows how HCI Footprint lets that agent work only through the actions you open to it: the user sees every step, approves what matters, and every step is logged.

libraries.name: HCI Footprint
libraries.about: A structured map of your app’s actions, navigation and permissions for AI agents.

libraries.name: AgentFootprint
libraries.about: Build and debug TypeScript agents with connected records of context, tools and outcomes.

madeWith.name: StoryDeck
madeWith.about: Write a talk once and show it as a deck, a scroll story or an article. These slides, with their click-by-click focus, run on it.

madeWith.name: StoryReel
madeWith.about: Films from a storyboard: every drawing tied to the phrase that says it, rendered to video. The talk’s teaser was made with it.
